description: Cold-outreach rules added on top of the shared English pack by scripts/lint_outreach.py (format: shared/schemas/copy-rules.schema.json). Openers, disclaimers, announced asks, staged setups, flattery and invented scarcity. Structural checks (length, links, tokens, signature, duplicates, numbers, sourced fact) live in the script, not here.

rules.pattern: \bI hope (?:this|my|you|you're|you are|all is)\b[^.!?\n]{0,40}\bwell\b|\bI trust this (?:email|message|note) finds\b|^\s*quick question\b|\bI came across your (?:profile|impressive|amazing|great)\b|\bI noticed (?:that )?you(?:'re| are) (?:a|the)\b
rules.message: Open on the fact you found about them, not on a ritual line.
bad: I hope this email finds you well.
I came across your profile on LinkedIn.
I noticed you're a founder at Acme.
good: Your post of 3 March on pricing pages stuck with me.
I hope to see you at the meetup.

rules.pattern: \b(?:no|not a|this is not a|this isn't a)\s+(?:sales\s+)?pitch\b|\bnot (?:trying|here) to sell\b|\bno strings attached\b
rules.message: Delete the disclaimer: a message that says it is not a pitch reads as one. Let the content show it.
bad: I'm not trying to sell you anything.
good: How did you pick your first ten design partners?

rules.pattern: \bI(?:'ll| will) (?:keep (?:this|it) (?:short|brief)|be (?:brief|quick|direct))\b|\bthe reason I(?:'m| am) (?:reaching out|writing|emailing)\b|\bI(?:'m| am) reaching out (?:because|to)\b|\blet me (?:get|cut) (?:straight )?to the (?:point|chase)\b
rules.message: Say the thing instead of announcing that you will say it.
bad: The reason I'm reaching out is simple.
I'm reaching out because we help founders.
good: We run a year-round program for first-time founders in Paris.

rules.pattern: \bif I(?:'m| am) (?:writing|reaching out) (?:to you )?(?:today|now)\b|\bthere(?:'s| is) a (?:specific |good )?reason I(?:'m| am) writing\b|\bI(?:'ll| will) be honest with you\b
rules.message: Drop the theatrical setup; open on the fact.
bad: If I'm writing to you today, it's for a specific reason.
good: I'm writing about your hiring post of 2 October.

rules.message: Replace the compliment with the specific point of their post you are reacting to.
good: Your point on annual plans made me check ours.

rules.message: Remove the pressure line; a real deadline goes in with its date and its source.
good: Applications for the October batch close on 21 October.

rules.pattern: \bdid I do something wrong\b|\byou must be (?:really |very )?busy\b|\bhaven'?t heard back\b
rules.message: Close the loop without guilt: one line that leaves the door open.
bad: I haven't heard back from you.
good: I'll stop here; reply any time if this becomes a priority.
